# Pass Logistics

Pass Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Pass Logistics is a UK logistics company for logistics transport, freight and warehousing. Pass Logistics employs 39 people (+5.4% YoY, +2 people), founded in 2017. Headquartered in Harworth, Northumberland, United Kingdom.

## About

Pass Logistics, founded in 2017, is a UK logistics company offering 3PL, warehousing, national same‑day courier, UK and European haulage, rail freight and container movement. They provide tailored transport, distribution and freight solutions with UK‑wide coverage and European reach.
